fact: In a written reply to NCOP question 274-2026 (question paper dated 20 March 2026) the Minister of Sport, Arts and Culture stated there is currently no standalone legislation regulating AI-generated likeness misuse, with protection resting on common law, POPIA and defamation.
title: Question No. 274-2026 written reply: Common law rights, particularly the right to dignity and personality
publisher: National Council of Provinces / Department of Sport, Arts and Culture
